audio.tooltip: The audio to add to the video.

bit_depth.tooltip: Auto uses 8-bit for sRGB and 10-bit for HDR. Explicit 8-bit and 10-bit choices are independent of colorspace.

color_space.tooltip: Colorspace of the input images. HDR selects BT.2020/HLG and HDR PQ selects BT.2020/PQ.

LoraLoaderModelOnly.name: LoraLoaderModelOnly
LoraLoaderModelOnly.description: This LoRAs loader is used to modify the diffusion model, altering the way in which latents are denoised such as applying styles. Multiple LoRA nodes can be linked together.

task.tooltip: The selected task controls which media inputs are shown.

MMH3Create.name: MMH3Create
MMH3Create.description: Describe an H3 generation and attach only the inputs required by the selected task.

MMH3H3AVCombine.name: MMH3H3AVCombine
MMH3H3AVCombine.description: Combine separated MiniMax H3 video/audio latents into one joint AV latent. Rejects batch/layout/duration mismatches instead of silently trimming or padding audio.

MMH3H3AVSeparate.name: MMH3H3AVSeparate
MMH3H3AVSeparate.description: Strictly split a MiniMax H3 joint AV latent into video and audio branches. Preserves auxiliary LATENT fields and split noise masks without copying tensor storage.

MMH3H3DecodedUpscalePrepare.description: F07 decoded-video entry path. Normalizes primary packet AV to the H3 grid, VAE-encodes it, preserves the audio latent and returns aligned learned-upscale geometry with vae_encoded provenance.

resolution.tooltip: Source keeps the original dimensions (aligned to 32), without resizing to a base resolution. Required for direct latent continuation.

MMH3H3GenerationSettings.name: MMH3H3GenerationSettings
MMH3H3GenerationSettings.description: Set output aspect ratio, resolution and video length with H3-safe alignment.

MMH3H3LatentUpscalePrepare.name: MMH3H3LatentUpscalePrepare
MMH3H3LatentUpscalePrepare.description: F07 packet/provenance/geometry boundary for a replaceable learned video-latent upscaler. Returns the original audio latent unchanged and exact aligned target dimensions.

MMH3H3LatentUpscaleTarget.name: MMH3H3LatentUpscaleTarget
MMH3H3LatentUpscaleTarget.display_name: MMH3 H3 Latent Upscale Refine Target
MMH3H3LatentUpscaleTarget.description: Build a strict joint H3 refine target from upscaled video and source audio. Native nested masks denoise video and lock audio.

vsa_dense_blocks.tooltip: Optional dense-only blocks. Changes the VSA execution recipe.

vdn_checkpoint.tooltip: Directory under ComfyUI/models/vdn, e.g. stage-dmd-step-250 or an INT8 ConvRot conversion.

vdn_apply_turbo_adapter.tooltip: ON: released DMD/turbo path; use 8 sampling steps. OFF: Stage-B path; use about 50 steps.

MMH3H3ModelOptimizations.name: MMH3H3ModelOptimizations
MMH3H3ModelOptimizations.description: Apply one H3 attention/architecture strategy plus optional scoped FP16 accumulation. VDN-H3 is an exclusive hybrid-attention architecture extension (FL2VA/Ref2VA) and requires the external ComfyUI-VDN-H3 runtime + VDN stage weights; do not stack it with Sol/SLA.

control_checkpoint.tooltip: Current #15975 MODEL_PATCH checkpoint. Preferred over legacy control_net inputs.

MMH3H3NativeTileRefine.name: MMH3H3NativeTileRefine
MMH3H3NativeTileRefine.description: Sequentially refine a decoded H3 video in spatial tiles using the supplied Guider/Sampler/Sigmas. Every tile carries the complete timeline, video uses an all-one noise mask, source audio uses an all-zero mask and sampled audio is discarded. The final composited video is VAE-encoded once and recombined with the exact source audio latent. Optional F16 inputs crop full-canvas control to each tile sample_rect before sampling; full-canvas control is never sent to a cropped latent.

turbo_override.tooltip: Replace only source acceleration LoRAs with this model-only LoRA at strength 1.

acceleration_policy.tooltip: drop removes source Turbo/PDD/FastH3 acceleration adapters but preserves creative/style/content LoRAs. Required when changing to a trajectory-owning architecture such as VDN.

MMH3H3RefineLoRAs.name: MMH3H3RefineLoRAs
MMH3H3RefineLoRAs.description: Reapply the packet's recorded source-generation LoRAs to standard MODEL/CLIP outputs in exact order before high-sigma refine. Missing/unknown overrides are explicit; hash mismatch blocks.

denoise_override.tooltip: 0 = source-aware auto. Non-zero is clamped to the safe 0.05–0.50 refine range.

MMH3H3UpscaleRefineSampling.name: MMH3H3UpscaleRefineSampling
MMH3H3UpscaleRefineSampling.description: Derive the HR second-pass sampler from the source MMH3 packet. Inherits task family, sampler/scheduler, steps and AV shifts, then truncates that same trajectory to a low-sigma tail so upscale refinement does not restart near sigma=1 and drift from source context.

file.tooltip: Archives in ComfyUI input/output. Use the standard ComfyUI Refresh (R), as with LoRA lists, to rescan files.

path_override.tooltip: Optional absolute/local path for automation. The file selector is ignored when set.

MMH3Load.name: MMH3Load
MMH3Load.description: Load packet.json and the ZIP directory only. Heavy media/latents remain lazy.

MMH3PackH3Result.name: MMH3PackH3Result
MMH3PackH3Result.description: Atomically pack standard H3 process outputs into a new packet and record one process-level provenance entry.

primary.tooltip: For video/audio/image/latent/mask, atomically replace and bind the primary resource. When enabled, role/order/mode are ignored and the resource is stored as auxiliary with no order.

resource_id.tooltip: Required for deterministic replace; blank lets MMH3 select by role/kind/order for upsert.

MMH3Put.name: MMH3Put
MMH3Put.description: Add or replace one canonical v0.3 resource.

filename_prefix.tooltip: Output-relative folder and filename. Extension is added automatically; existing names get a numeric suffix unless overwrite is enabled.

target.tooltip: Output creates an archive. Source replaces the original file, ignores Filename and requires overwrite.

overwrite.tooltip: Allow replacing an existing archive at the resolved path. Keep off for safer iterative work.

MMH3Save.name: MMH3Save
MMH3Save.description: Save a self-contained MMH3 archive with image/video previews. Existing media are byte-copied when possible.

mode.tooltip: How the target size is computed.

enable_temporal_chunking.tooltip: Enable temporal chunking to save VRAM for long videos and fix end-frame flickering.

force_unload.tooltip: Unload model to CPU after inference to free VRAM for subsequent nodes. Disable if you run this node repeatedly to avoid reload overhead.
